note: Bank statement item "December Days: Navy Day, Human Rights Day and Kisan Diwas" listing 18 December days. This chapter teaches 17 of the 18 listed days from official GoI sources across sections s1–s6 (its three embedded questions — Human Rights Day/UDHR, Navy Day/Operation Trident, December-chain matching — are all covered: q08/q11, q15/q18, q28/q35/q42). NOT taught from this list: 9 Dec International Anti-Corruption Day and 18 Dec International Migrants Day — no allowed-publisher (gov.in/nic.in/NCERT) source stating them could be fetched; disclosed as gaps in REPORT.md.
Real PYQ (WBPSC Clerkship Part-I 2023, Session II, Q52): "Which day is observed as World AIDS Day?" — answer 1 December. Taught in s1 (claim c01) and practised in q01/q07/q42.
Real PYQ (WBCS Prelims 2018, Q191): FAO observes 5 December as World Soil Day. Taught in s4 (claim c09) and practised in q22/q26/q28.

Real PYQ (WBCS Prelims 2016, Q54) asking the theme of Human Rights Day 2015 ("Our Rights, Our Freedoms, Always"). NOT taught as content: an annual theme is year-specific and this chapter deliberately teaches themes only with their year attached (it teaches the 2024 theme, claim c16, and the theme-with-year method in s3/q06/q20). The 2015 theme itself is not asserted anywhere in the chapter; students are warned in exam_focus that theme questions must be matched by year.
